QM-One

Quantum Motion

QM-One

Quantum Motion · semiconductor spins · DEPLOYED (15 Sep 2025) · qubits not published · access: on-prem (NQCC testbed programme)
architecture: ספינים בנקודות קוונטיות בסיליקון / גרמניום · Open on the map

Register profile — the machine's variant of its architecture

qubit type: Si-MOS gate-defined electron spin
gate mechanism: exchange 2Q, ESR/EDSR 1Q
connectivity: "scalable tile architecture"; degree not published
control: integrated cryo-CMOS on the qubit die; three 19-inch server racks with the dilution refrigerator inside the footprint
control placement: cryo-CMOS on-die
readout: rf single-electron-box gate-based reflectometry - 99.2% in under 6 us
flags: count unpublished, no published error rates, source not confirmed
